'''Masahito Hayashi''' is a Japanese professor<ref name="CUHK_HayashiBio">{{cite web |last1=Hayashi |first1=Masahito |title=HAYASHI, Masahito |url=https://sds.cuhk.edu.cn/en/teacher/927 |website=sds.cuhk.edu.cn |publisher=The Chinese University of Hong Kong |access-date=9 May 2026 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260122135538/https://sds.cuhk.edu.cn/en/teacher/927 |archive-date=22 Jan 2026}}</ref> working on quantum statistical inference and quantum information theory.<ref name="HayashiPersonalWebsite">{{cite web |last1=Hayashi |first1=Masahito |title=Masahito Hayashi |url=https://mhayashi.info/about.html |website=mhayashi.info |publisher=Masahito Hayashi |access-date=7 May 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260222081639/https://mhayashi.info/about.html|archive-date=22 February 2026}}</ref> He is known for his contributions to statistical inference for quantum systems<ref name="HayashiCQTAwardPage" />, quantum hypothesis testing, quantum resource theories,<ref name="ResourceTheory_PressRelease">{{cite web |title=New Research on the Resource Theory of Quantum Channels {{!}} Shenzhen Institute for Quantum Science and Engineering |url=https://siqse.sustech.edu.cn/en/Index/view/mid/18/id/799?play=0 |website=siqse.sustech.edu.cn |publisher=siqse.sustech.edu.cn/ |access-date=16 May 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211018022147/https://siqse.sustech.edu.cn/en/Index/view/mid/18/id/799?play=0 |archive-date=18 Oct 2021}}</ref> and has published several books on the topics. Hayashi was a part of a team that reproved the [[generalized Quantum Stein's Lemma]]<ref name="PhysOrgArticle_GenQuanSteins">{{cite web |last1=Fadelli |first1=Ingrid |title=Physicists repair flaw of established quantum resource theorem |url=https://phys.org/news/2025-12-physicists-flaw-quantum-resource-theorem.html |website=phys.org |publisher=Phys.org |access-date=9 May 2026| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260201044752/https://phys.org/news/2025-12-physicists-flaw-quantum-resource-theorem.html | archive-date=1 Feb 2026}}</ref><ref name="GenQuantSteins_Paper">{{cite journal |last1=Hayashi |first1=Masahito |last2=Yamasaki |first2=Hayata |title=The generalized quantum Stein's lemma and the second law of quantum resource theories |journal=Nature Physics |date=December 2025 |volume=21 |issue=12 |pages=1988–1993 |doi=10.1038/s41567-025-03047-9 |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/s41567-025-03047-9 |access-date=9 May 2026 | arxiv=2408.02722}}</ref> which was published at roughly the same time as the proof by Ludovico Lami.

Hayashi was named an [[Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers|IEEE]] fellow in 2017 for his contributions to Shannon theory, information-theoretic security, and quantum information theory.<ref>{{cite web
|title=Prof. Masahito Hayashi Selected as IEEE Fellow {{!}} News & Events
|url=https://en.nagoya-u.ac.jp/news/articles/award_121/
|website=Nagoya University
|access-date=10 August 2026
|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260311165453/https://en.nagoya-u.ac.jp/news/articles/award_121/
|archive-date=March 11, 2026
|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=2017 New Fellows |url=https://ieee-jp.org/en/kaiin/fellow/fellow17.html |website=IEEE Japan Council |publisher=IEEE Japan Council |access-date=10 August 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250522122308/https://ieee-jp.org/en/kaiin/fellow/fellow17.html | archive-date=May 22, 2025}}</ref> Hayashi was selected to be a fellow of the Asia Pacific Artificial Intelligence Association in 2022,<ref>{{cite web |title=International Academy of Artificial Intelligence Sciences |url=https://www.aaia-ai.org/fellows?page=80 |website=www.aaia-ai.org |access-date=10 August 2026 |pages=80}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Researchers make progress on quantum dense coding with locality constraints on decoder {{!}} Shenzhen Institute for Quantum Science and Engineering |url=https://siqse.sustech.edu.cn/en/Index/view/id/1322?play=0 |website=siqse.sustech.edu.cn |access-date=10 August 2026}}</ref> the same year he became a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} 2022 IMS Fellows Announced |url=https://imstat.org/2022/04/22/2022-ims-fellows-announced/ |website=imstat.org |publisher=Institute of Mathematical Statistics |access-date=10 August 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260316210214/https://imstat.org/2022/04/22/2022-ims-fellows-announced/ |archive-date=March 16, 2026 |language=en}}</ref>

==Books==
* ''Asymptotic Theory Of Quantum Statistcial Inference: Selected Papers'', 2005, World Scientific Publishing, {{doi | 10.1142/5630}}
* ''Quantum Computation and Information'', 2006, Springer Berlin, Heidelberg, {{doi | 10.1007/3-540-33133-6}}
* ''Introduction to Quantum Information Science'', 2014, Springer Berlin, Heidelberg, {{doi | 10.1007/978-3-662-43502-1}}
* ''Quantum Information Theory'', 2017, Springer-Verlag,  Heidelber, {{doi | 10.1007/978-3-662-49725-8}}
* ''Group Representation for Quantum Theory'', 2017, Springer Cham, {{doi | 10.1007/978-3-319-44906-7}}
* ''A Group Theoretic Approach to Quantum Information'', 2017, Springer Cham, {{doi | 10.1007/978-3-319-45241-8 }}
*
